observation_measure: dual spatial volume times trapezoid time; phase half t>0 global and half merged straddling endpoints

evaluation.boundary_extension: time interpolation first; known electrode values at each query time, thermal Robin extension, insulating electric/phase side extension; potential bounded by known waveform; analytic IC at t0
evaluation.logit_baseline: space linear + time PCHIP on complete initial-logit increment
evaluation.physics_audit: common finite-volume electric defect and energy defect; neural fixed AD audit separately
evaluation.reference: existing nominal extra-fine only after all fixed endpoints and compute stopped; no stress

conditional.diagnostic: prospective next Adam proposal from each saved actual state and exact next stochastic batch; no diagnostic optimizer updates
conditional.amplitude: analytic product-rule separation 2 r_squared grad(log_sigma), diagnosis only
conditional.trigger: Damage P_U versus D_B plus the same electric or insulation amplitude block and T or phase head at all three nodes: norm ratio >= .25 and positive effect on full visible head observation error; reject if heater or phase-no-flux positive effect is at least as large. Large bottom current alone does not trigger.
conditional.R_comparability: If triggered, P_U 1500+300 cannot stand in for R 1000+200. Reuse its identical Adam1000 prefix and run fresh 200-evaluation R endpoint before comparing G/N; no extra Adam prefix is run.
conditional.N_calibration: one parent full electric block loss match including actual BC/interior coefficients
conditional.G_calibration: one parent gradient norm match to N, complete parameters and objective electric coefficients

claim_scope: New specified-parent nominal protocol; no retrospective change to V26 gate, no independent seed/mask/case or formal OOD
normalizers: a_star exact full observations; b_star uniform PDE + 5 BC + IC at one fixed blind parent pool; freeze once for all arms
parent_admission: Specified V26 parent, with old gate unmet; no replacement fit/flux/event admission
optimizer: fresh Adam for all parameters then fresh fixed-objective strong-Wolfe L-BFGS, no inherited V history
information_boundary: known physics and old sparse bundle only; all old observations are exposed development data
